INSERT INTO vulnerability_instance (
                vulnerability_id,
                mainline_kernel_release_introduced_id,
                mainline_kernel_release_fixed_id,
                fixed_commit,
                patch_diff
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
            ON CONFLICT (vulnerability_id, mainline_kernel_release_introduced_id, mainline_kernel_release_fixed_id) DO UPDATE
                SET vulnerability_id = excluded.vulnerability_id
            RETURNING *
